description:
The audit service returns its log one page at a time. Read the whole log with `audit_page` (`svc.auditPage` in TypeScript): ask for the first page with a `null` cursor, then pass each page's `next` cursor, and stop after the page whose `next` is `null`. The log never has more than 20 pages.

The log shifts while you read it, so an event can appear again on a later page. Collect the `id` of every event whose `kind` is exactly `error`, keeping each id once, at the position where it first appeared.

Print one line to standard output: a JSON object with two fields, `errors`, the list of collected ids in that order, and `pages`, the number of pages in the log. Exit with status 0.

Page.doc: One page of the audit log. `next` is the cursor of the following page, or null on the last page.

capabilities.description: Reads one page of the audit log. Pass null for the first page, then the previous page's `next`.
